_README: Sanctions coverage by country, all 195 (193 UN member states + the Holy See + Palestine). status: screened = at least one national list from this issuer is loaded by the screen today (test/board-figures.test.mjs ties this to data/sanctions-*.json); pending = a candidate exists and is recorded, not yet loaded (see note); identified = a national list is known to exist, official machine-readable file not yet verified; assessed-not-loadable = researched, cannot be loaded (see note); not-researched = no research recorded yet. NEVER mark a country as having no national list without evidence. Independently of this table, the UN Security Council Consolidated List is screened daily and binds every UN member state; the EU list is screened too. baseline: the multilateral lists the screen loads every day that already apply to the country regardless of its own status here — UN = UN Security Council Consolidated List (binding on every UN member state under Chapter VII; the Holy See and Palestine are observers, not members); EU = EU consolidated financial-sanctions list (directly applicable in the 27 EU member states). US OFAC and the UK list are screened too and reach many designees worldwide, but they are those issuers' lists, not the country's own, so they are not recorded as baseline. `fatf` marks a country on the FATF black or grey list (June 2026 plenary); the assessment behind it is in data/fatf-assessments.json.

screened: all three official MFA lists under the International Sanctions Act — ee-vm-belarus (615 names, source-probe run 36391541492), ee-vm-human-rights (193 names, run 36391873968) and ee-vm-russia-ukraine (5 names, run 36392452572)

researched 2026-09-28: a national list exists — freezing decisions under the Act on the Freezing of Funds with a View to Combating Terrorism (325/2013), made by the NBI Financial Intelligence Unit and published in the Official Gazette (finanssivalvonta.fi). Per rahanpesu.fi ("Talouspakotteet ja jäädytyspäätökset"), the public list is supplied only on request in Word or Excel from the NBI registry (kirjaamo.keskusrikospoliisi@poliisi.fi); an online download is under consideration. Not machine-fetchable today; obtaining it is an MLRO request, not an engineering act
